description: A credential that declares neither `platform_operator` nor an `organization_id` is unclassifiable once the deprecated compatibility switch is off (#515). `finalize_auth` refuses it rather than guessing a tenancy: the alternative -- treating an omitted field as platform root -- is the exact default #515 exists to remove, and guessing a tenant would be worse. The posture needs BOTH halves to be reachable: `[tenancy] implicit_platform_operator = false`, and a key that states no identity at all. With the switch on (the deprecated default) this same key is still admitted as root, which is what #540 flips.

api_keys.name: key that names neither a tenant nor platform root
